meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru launched a Toronto mobile physiotherapy service on Google Ads with clean lead tracking, building an early flow of 4 to 9 genuine leads a month and expanding reach with Performance Max.

headline: Launching a Mobile Physiotherapy Service on Google Ads
summary_line: PPC Guru launched a Toronto mobile physiotherapy service on Google Ads in early 2026 with clean lead tracking in place from day one. In its first five months the account has produced a steady early flow of four to nine genuine phone and form leads a month, and reach expanded sharply after a Performance Max campaign was added — an early-stage foundation now being scaled.
client_context: Rehab2Go is a mobile physiotherapy and rehabilitation service that brings treatment to patients in their own homes across Toronto. Its patients often search specifically for at-home care — in-home physiotherapy, home-visit rehab, and physiotherapy for seniors or post-surgery recovery. Because the service is delivered at home rather than at a clinic, phone calls and form enquiries are the core way new patients get in touch, which makes reliable lead tracking essential from the outset.
background: Rehab2Go came to PPC Guru to build a Google Ads presence from scratch and reach people actively searching for at-home physiotherapy. PPC Guru launched the account in early 2026 with call and form tracking in place, starting on Search and later adding Performance Max to widen reach.
analysis: As a brand-new account, the priority was a clean measurement foundation and tightly relevant early traffic. PPC Guru set up genuine-lead tracking first, focused Search on high-intent at-home queries, and then introduced Performance Max to expand reach once the tracking was trusted.
analysis_points: Set up genuine-lead tracking (phone calls and form submissions) before scaling spend.
Focus Search on high-intent at-home queries such as 'in home physiotherapy toronto' and 'mobile physiotherapist'.
Add a Performance Max campaign to widen reach beyond core Search once tracking was trusted.
Keep early traffic relevant with ongoing search-term and negative-keyword work.

timeline.what: Search campaign launched with call and form tracking — 7 genuine leads in the first month.
Account settled into a steady 4–5 genuine leads a month as targeting was refined.
Performance Max added; reach began expanding (impressions to ~6,500) at 7 genuine leads.
Reach expanded sharply to about 18,000 impressions a month at 9 genuine leads — the account's best month so far.

challenge: Starting a brand-new mobile-physiotherapy account means building demand and data at the same time. At-home physiotherapy is a specific, lower-volume search category, so the early goal was a clean tracking foundation and relevant traffic rather than large lead numbers — and then a way to widen reach without losing that relevance.

changes.why: Phone-call and form-submission tracking captured real enquiries from day one, with no vanity actions inflating the counts.
Budget concentrated on at-home and mobile physiotherapy searches so early spend reached people wanting home visits.
Added once tracking was trusted, to widen reach across Google's surfaces and grow impressions and clicks.
Ongoing negative-keyword work kept the small early budget on relevant, treatment-intent queries.

benchmark: This is an early-stage account with only about five months of history and low overall lead volume, so figures are shown honestly as a launch snapshot rather than a matured result. Cost per lead rose as reach was deliberately expanded; the next few months will show whether that reach converts efficiently at scale.
gradual: Across its first five months the account produced 7, 4, 5, 7 and 9 genuine leads a month — a low but steady flow while the campaigns gathered data. The clearest shift so far is in reach: after Performance Max was added, monthly impressions grew from a few hundred to about 18,000 by July, with clicks rising from 67 to 275. Lead count is growing more gradually, which is expected for a specialised at-home service in its first months.
lessons: Put genuine-lead tracking in place before scaling — phone calls and forms are the enquiries that matter.
Expect specialised, at-home search categories to start at lower volume than clinic-based ones.
Prove relevance on Search before widening reach with Performance Max.
Give a new account several months of data before judging cost per lead.
Watch reach and lead count together, so growth in impressions translates into real enquiries.
why_it_worked: A clean tracking foundation meant every reported lead was a genuine phone or form enquiry.
Early Search budget stayed on high-intent at-home queries.
Performance Max expanded reach once the account had trustworthy conversion signals.
Ongoing search-term work kept a small budget relevant.
outcome: Rehab2Go is early in its Google Ads journey. In its first five months the account has built a clean tracking foundation and a steady early flow of four to nine genuine phone and form leads a month, and reach has expanded roughly 38-fold since launch after Performance Max was introduced. The next phase is about converting that widened reach into a higher, efficient lead volume — the account is a work in progress with the fundamentals in place, and is flagged for continued review as more data accumulates.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian healthcare and at-home care providers launch Google Ads with honest lead tracking and a clear plan to scale.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the account's Google Ads data and shown on a monthly basis. 'Leads' are genuine phone calls and form submissions only; this account records no vanity local actions. 'Now' is the most recent complete month (July 2026); the launch month (March 2026) is the baseline. Given the short history and low volume, this study is flagged for review.
lead_quality: All tracked leads are direct phone calls and form submissions from people searching for at-home physiotherapy — no button-click or local-action inflation is included.
teaser: 🏥 Mobile physiotherapy Google Ads: PPC Guru launched Rehab2Go's at-home physio account with clean lead tracking, building an early 4–9 leads/month and expanding reach ~38x with Performance Max. Early-stage and scaling.
